description: This file defines the ViewListView class for rendering and managing the list view interface of the Module Builder in SuiteCRM, including its display logic, AJAX construction, and Smarty template integration.

classes.name: ViewListView
classes.description: Class responsible for rendering and handling the list view in the Module Builder interface, including construction of Smarty templates, AJAX navigation, and UI controls.

methods.name: _getModuleTitleParams
methods.description: Returns parameters for the module title, localized module name and module title.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the ViewListView object with request parameters determining the module, layout, subpanel, and package context.

methods.name: preDisplay
methods.description: Placeholder method overriding parent preDisplay, intentionally left empty.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Renders the list view, either as a preview or full AJAX-loaded content, by preparing the Smarty template.

methods.name: constructAjax
methods.description: Builds the AJAX navigation breadcrumb trail based on whether the view is from Module Builder or Studio, and subpanel context.

methods.name: constructSmarty
methods.description: Prepares and assigns variables to the Smarty template for displaying the list view, including columns, buttons, and contextual data.

methods.name: _constructTitle
methods.description: Constructs the page title based on module and subpanel context.

methods.name: _buildImageButtons
methods.description: Generates HTML for an array of buttons with icons and scripts, optionally laid out horizontally or vertically.
